en: The image shows a black and white photograph of a compound with a central building in the background, flanked by several corrugated iron barracks or huts. There are a number of people, possibly in uniform or hospital attire, gathered in front of the central building. The area is framed by newly planted trees and the ground appears to be bare dirt or gravel. The architectural style and corrugated huts suggest a utilitarian or temporary structure, likely from the early 20th century.
